purpose: Consolidate the seven M-04D fog-resolution waves into one adjudication ledger that distinguishes bounded support, explicit non-links, unresolved acquisitions, and system-wide propositions that remain candidate-only.

post_Cold_War_externalization_and_phase_.scope: institution-level periodization and mechanisms, not one continuous centrally planned project

strategic_ambiguity_as_role_and_conversi.scope: bounded procurement, platform, capital, policy, and public-private role transitions

public_conversion.scope: multiple exact approvals, procurements, enterprise vehicles, prototype-to-production paths, and public market mechanisms

deliberate_market_shaping.scope: Palantir DCGS-A2 commercial-item gate challenge only; improper tailoring and later-award causation unresolved

institutional_replacement_and_dependency.scope: bounded Army enterprise, ICE ICM, NGC2 division implementation, and ImmigrationOS/ERO lanes

multi_company_operational_integration.scope: Palantir-Anduril-Raft and other NGC2 roles plus bounded Brave1 integration

operational_feedback_and_replication.scope: NGC2 soldier feedback and intra-Army scaling; Ukraine combat-data, procurement, industrial, interoperability, and standards mechanisms

partial_resource_metabolism.scope: Palantir public-demand/private-revenue and mixed-rights cycle plus public Brave1 feedback-market cycle; full private gate-feedback loop unresolved

coercive_ideological_governance.scope: ImmigrationOS policy-to-system predicates supported; case-level consequence, mandatory use, weak contestability, and intent-to-effect chain absent

personal_extraction.scope: government revenue, founder control, and private platform rights documented; award-level economics and causal founder-benefit chain absent

system_wide_deliberate_coordinated_captu.scope: bounded mechanisms and integrations do not establish one founder-controlled network spanning companies, funds, banks, policy institutions, agencies, theaters, consequences, and residual rights

organism_conclusion.scope: no workflow, aggregate, or local lane may generate system organism membership

ordinary_shared_ecology_null.scope: remains a material system-wide alternative alongside publicly directed adaptation, competition, and multi-institutional governance

phase_adjudication.ceiling: acquisition-workforce retrenchment, contractor reliance, and persistent contract-management risk
large-scale expeditionary contractor use and incomplete personnel and oversight data
DIU commercial-technology bridge, prototype awards, and production-transition mechanism
scaled flexible acquisition, nontraditional participation, and bounded platform operating layers
enterprise procurement, public market creation, battlefield-feedback scaling, production transfer, and standards diffusion

intentionality_adjudication.ceiling: bounded market positioning, contract pursuit, and ordinary advocacy
Palantir DCGS-A2 gate challenge; broader and improper shaping unresolved
bounded Army, ICE, NGC2, and ImmigrationOS operating lanes
policy-to-system design and deployment predicates only
ingredients without a causal and disproportionate private-benefit chain

organism_test_adjudication.basis: explicit NGC2 public-program purpose connected to contracts and implementation; no system-wide private common purpose
source-explicit differentiated NGC2 roles; no estate-wide functional closure
partial Palantir and Brave1 cycles; complete public-risk/private-rights/gate-feedback cycle absent
exact NGC2 and Brave1 integration; no common governance across the estate
public onboarding and marketplace mechanisms; private-network authorship and control unresolved
NGC2 operational feedback and exact Ukraine procurement, production, interoperability, and standards mechanisms
core governance and revenue architecture publicly disclosed; end-to-end operational responsibility and intent remain unresolved
NGC2 military training decision-effect chain; civilian consequence, weak contestability, and extraction absent

required_objects: officer and supervisor decisions and overrides
notice, correction, complaint, administrative review, litigation, and final disposition
next_decisive_frontier.terminal_condition: supported consequential chain, bounded non-link, or source restriction with exact unavailable records

next_decisive_frontier.question: Does any ICM-derived field, analytic, alert, identifier, or workflow output materially enter ECTS/EID Risk Classification Assessments?
next_decisive_frontier.terminal_condition: material interface supported or indirect join closed as bounded non-link

code, architecture, ontology, model, and data lineage

board, conflict, recusal, and related-party records

next_decisive_frontier.question: Does legal, contractual, semantic, geographic, or system fragmentation deliberately prevent reconstruction of integrated responsibility while preserving function?
required_objects: entity, brand, contract, module, data, interface, decision, and consequence crosswalk
redaction, classification, FOIA, disclosure, and records-retention history
authorship, control, operating responsibility, and intent
next_decisive_frontier.terminal_condition: deliberate membrane supported, ordinary complexity favored, or proposition narrowed to specific missing surfaces

next_decisive_frontier.question: Were complementary companies, vehicles, standards, and teams privately assembled to fill predetermined functions, or publicly and competitively assembled around changing institutional needs?
required_objects: complete applicant, proposal, company, fund, team, and component denominators
Government market research, scoring, exclusions, and onboarding
redundancy, replacement, failure, and nonnetwork controls
repeat design across independently governed programs
next_decisive_frontier.terminal_condition: private reproduction supported, public assembly favored, or mixed mechanism resolved by function and date

next_decisive_frontier.question: After all bounded lanes terminate, do common governance, planning, operating integration, transfers, consequences, resource cycles, visibility management, and counterpower results establish one coordinated system?
required_objects: ordinary, competitive, unsuccessful, contradictory, and null controls
next_decisive_frontier.terminal_condition: system proposition supported for named human review, retained candidate-only, bounded non-link, or falsified without aggregation shortcuts

interpretation.what_changed: The adversarial triage no longer consists mainly of generic unknowns. It now contains supported bounded mechanisms, explicit non-links, and a small exact acquisition frontier.
interpretation.what_did_not_change: No bounded lane promotes a system-wide organism, coordinated capture, coercive governance, extraction, or wrongdoing conclusion.
interpretation.current_best_model: Post-Cold War public-capacity externalization and changing acquisition institutions created recurring public-private conversion opportunities. Some actors deliberately shaped gates; some private platforms became bounded operating layers; exact multi-company integrations, feedback loops, public markets, and transfers exist. Public institutions, competition, alternative vendors, formal remedies, and independent architectures remain material causal and governance forces. System-wide founder-controlled common design remains unproved.
